description: This script manages cron jobs for uploading WiFi logs by starting or stopping a scheduled task that runs a separate log copying script every 30 minutes.

methods.name: start_cron_job
methods.description: Starts a cron job to periodically copy WiFi logs by adding an entry to the crontab.

methods.name: stop_cron_job
methods.description: Stops the WiFi log copying cron job by removing relevant entries from the crontab.
